prophetConfiguration.note: Per Tech Spec Section 3.2 - Prophet configuration for financial forecasting
prophetConfiguration.code:
from prophet import Prophet import pandas as pd
model = Prophet( yearly_seasonality=True, quarterly_seasonality=True, changepoint_prior_scale=0.05 # Conservative (prevent overfitting) )
# Prepare DataFrame for Prophet (requires 'ds' and 'y' columns) df = pd.DataFrame({ 'ds': [p.date for p in historical_data.points], 'y': [p.value for p in historical_data.points] })
# Fit and predict model.fit(df) future = model.make_future_dataframe(periods=periods_ahead, freq='Q') forecast = model.predict(future)
# Extract confidence intervals yhat = forecast['yhat'].values[-periods_ahead:] yhat_lower = forecast['yhat_lower'].values[-periods_ahead:] yhat_upper = forecast['yhat_upper'].values[-periods_ahead:]
